overview: White plays 2.g4 against the Indian and after 2...Nxg4 has given a pawn. Play continues 3.e4 or Nf3 with a lead in development, but Black can keep the extra pawn. It is a rare gambit with a dubious reputation.

white_ideas.idea: Develop quickly with e4, Nf3 and Bf4
Hit the knight with Bf4/Nd2 to win time

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with White development lead

character.notes: A forcing line with a pawn deficit for White.

gambit.notes: The g4 pawn is taken by the knight and can be kept.

soundness.notes: White has little for the pawn.

sublines_that_differ.name: Declined
sublines_that_differ.how: No pawn is taken and White weakens the king.

character.reason: White gives up a pawn for a lead in development.

gambit.reason: The g4 pawn is taken and Black can keep it.

soundness.reason: Black stays a pawn up with a clean game.

level.reason: A dubious gambit is not Beginner.

plans.reason: White hopes for development and an open g-file.
